summary: TYPE_COLOR.skill='#bb88ff' (=--pur) and CSS .si-state.active{color:var(--pur)} (=#bb88ff) are identical. E77 identified this as a JS STATE_COLOR collision; E79 confirms the collision is at the CSS rendering layer (.si-state.active). For sk1 (type=skill, state=active), si-dot renders --pur and si-state.active renders var(--pur) — indistinguishable. Viewer cannot tell 'this node is a skill' (TYPE identity) from 'this node is in active state' (STATE status). Fix domain: CSS .si-state.active, not JS STATE_COLOR (which has no active→active CSS binding). Proposed: .si-state.active → #9966cc (dim-purple, distinct from --pur).
